difficulty_reason: The authors prove a new even-connection colon-graph lemma that transports local deletion neighborhoods through polarization, including a nontrivial induced-subgraph comparison. They then combine simultaneous induction on ideal power and graph size with a vertex-cover exact-sequence filtration to obtain a uniform bound for every power from a deletion-monotone hierarchy function. The complete local colon-graph construction and proof are retained, beyond routine calculation of one edge-ideal regularity; named commutative-algebra prerequisites remain distinct uncounted context.
